description: The three Axiom monitor groups (I2), matching the accepted architecture: processing/save incidents, recovery/health including external backend-silence detection, and costs/limits with the 400/500 PLN alerts. Axiom Personal permits at most three monitors - these are all three. PROVISIONING IS PENDING (see README.md): no Axiom account exists yet; the APL queries and notification channels below are the exact definitions to create once the owner provisions the account.

monitors.apl: ['kiero-observability'] | where kind in ['ops.processing.failed', 'ops.processing.stuck', 'ops.save.failed', 'ops.job.attempts_exhausted', 'ops.outbox.delivery_failed'] | summarize count() by kind
monitors.covers: Failed and stuck processing runs, source save incidents, durable jobs that exhausted maxAttempts across every replay, and failed outbox deliveries (incl. the loud consumer_projection_missing failure kind).

Total backend silence detected OUTSIDE Convex: the gateway cron (external prober) emits heartbeat events to the sink; when they stop arriving, the backend (or the whole delivery path) is silent even though no application event can report it. Convex-side staleness (healthHeartbeats table + telemetry state) is the in-app second layer; backup freshness for I5 rides ops.health.heartbeat of backup.job plus the recovery manifest state.

monitors.apl: ['kiero-observability'] | where kind in ['ops.cost.threshold_warning', 'ops.cost.threshold_alert'] | summarize count() by level
monitors.covers: All-in monthly infrastructure + AI spend crossing 400 PLN (warning) and 500 PLN (stronger alert). Threshold evaluation and per-level 24h cooldown run Convex-side (costs.ts, evaluateCostAlerts); this monitor only notifies on the emitted alert events. No automatic product shutdown at 500 PLN (accepted alpha contract).
